name: ava-workbuddy-assistant
description: Analyze local CSV and Excel files with AVA and create traceable reports.

displayDescription.zh: 分析本地表格，拆解指标变化、核对计算口径，交付结论、结果表与交互图表，生成可追溯的分析报告。
displayDescription.en: Analyze local CSV and Excel files, explain metric changes, and check metric definitions. Deliver findings, result tables, interactive charts and a traceable report.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 分析这份表格，概括关键指标并生成报告。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Summarize key metrics in this spreadsheet and create a report.

quickPrompts.zh: 分析这份表格，概括关键指标并生成报告。
quickPrompts.en: Summarize key metrics in this spreadsheet and create a report.

quickPrompts.zh: 对比两个时期，找出对指标变化贡献最大的项目。
quickPrompts.en: Compare two periods and identify the largest contributors to the metric change.

quickPrompts.zh: 核对这个指标的计算口径和结果。
quickPrompts.en: Check how this metric is calculated and verify the result.
